allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Geeky teenager David and his popular twin sister, Jennifer, get sucked into the black-and-white world of a 1950s TV sitcom called "Pleasantville," and find a world where everything is peachy keen all the time. But when Jennifer's modern attitude disrupts Pleasantville's peaceful but boring routine, she literally brings color into its life.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: When modern impulses breach the flawless monochrome town, the arrival of literal color threatens to upend everything the community takes for granted.
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Transported into the black-and-white realm of a cheerful 1950s sitcom, teenage twins David and Jennifer confront an idyllic world whose tidy, predictable routine shatters when modern habits introduce vivid color.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: A steady, thoughtful fantasy comedy pairing imaginative visual style with engaged, moderate-weight family viewing.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Gary Ross crafts an inventive fantasy that blends gentle comedy with thoughtful drama, turning a nostalgic television frame into a striking study of conformity and awakening.
